_comment: Nox shell (qs -c nox) user config. Live-reloaded. Missing keys fall back to built-in defaults (core/Config.qml). Widget ids: modules/bar/BarWidgets.qml; control-center section ids: modules/controlcenter/CcSections.qml; launcher provider ids: modules/launcher/LauncherProviders.qml; action names (logo menu, session, commands): services/Actions.qml.

usage._comment: plan usage (Claude 5-hour / weekly, Codex). Claude numbers come from the Claude Code statusline via ~/.local/lib/nox/usage (install snippet in its header). warnAt: % that turns accent (95+ pulses). account: which login the bar shows (statusline tee name, 'claude' = ~/.claude). codex: read ~/.codex/sessions every codexInterval ms (60 s while the popover is open).

session._comment: restart/poweroff first snapshot the open windows as session 'last' (nox workspaces; 4 s cap, never blocks the action)

restart: timeout 4 nox workspaces save last --quiet; exec systemctl reboot
poweroff: timeout 4 nox workspaces save last --quiet; exec systemctl poweroff

screenshot._comment: Card after every capture (nox shot region|screen|window|all, modules/shot). The capture is only on the clipboard (and in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/nox-shot) until Save copies it to ~/Pictures/Screenshots. card.actions: save | folder (after save) | annotate | copy | pin | phone | upload | delete (discard, or Trash once saved); phone shows only while the phone link is up. annotate: argv with {file} (default nox shot annotate: satty, the card comes back with the result). upload.service: 0x0 (public, secret URL, deleted after `expires` hours) | none (hides the button) | any name with upload.command = argv using {file} / {expires}, first URL on stdout is copied. Upload always asks first unless upload.confirm is false.

ask._comment: Circle to Ask (Super+Shift+A, `nox ask`, IPC target ask; modules.ask: false turns it off). model: Claude Code model id or alias (claude-sonnet-5-5: ~1 s to the first token; opus: ~0.5 s slower). claude: path to the Claude Code CLI. extraArgs: more `claude -p` flags. timeout: ms to the first token before it gives up. agent: what Send to agent opens: "claude", "codex", "gemini", "opencode", or a command array with {prompt} / {image} / {keep} placeholders. agentDir: where it starts ("auto" = a path in the circled window's title, else ~). systemPrompt: replaces the built-in one (modules/ask/AskSession.qml).

stats._comment: bar widget 'stats' (widgets.stats.show: cpu | mem | temp | net). Sampled from /proc + /sys every interval ms; thermalZone: auto or a /sys/class/thermal zone number.

agents._comment: Mission Control for coding agents (Ctrl+Super+M, `nox agents`, bar widget 'agents'; modules.agents: false turns it off). Fed by the Claude Code hook ~/.local/lib/nox/agent-hook (install snippet in its header). notify: one notification per permission request while the overlay is closed. usageInterval: ms between transcript reads while open. keepEndedMinutes: how long ended sessions stay. prices: { "<model-id prefix>": [in, out, cacheRead] } $/Mtok overrides; contextWindow: { "<prefix>": tokens }.

desktopWidgets._comment: Clock / date / system / now playing / activity / quote column on the empty desktop (bottom layer, shown only while the workspace has no windows). side: left | right | auto (auto = the darker side of the wallpaper). show: any of date, clock, system, media, activity, quote, in order. system: readout items (host, uptime, cpu, mem, temp, battery). media: {art, progress, bars} (bars need cava). activity: {source: github (gh CLI) | local (git repos under ~/code), weeks} via `nox activity`. timeFormat/dateFormat: Qt formats (seconds in timeFormat tick every second). marginX: px from the screen edge; offsetY: px from vertical centre (+ = down). screens: [] = all. Runtime on/off and side (`nox widgets on|off|toggle|left|right|auto|reset`) are kept in ~/.local/state/nox/widgets.json over these.
quotes: Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability. — Edsger Dijkstra
Make it work, make it right, make it fast. — Kent Beck
The details are not the details. They make the design. — Charles Eames

web._comment: default: engine key (g Google, d DuckDuckGo, yt, gh, aw Arch Wiki, aur, ap Arch packages, r Reddit, w Wikipedia, npm, mdn); engines: { "key": { "name": "…", "url": "https://…?q=%s" } } adds/overrides, null removes; fallbackBelow: 0 = no unprefixed web row

palette._comment: command palette (Ctrl+Super+Space): nox actions, toggles with state, looks, nox CLI, phone, commands.items, every Hyprland bind with its keys

voice._comment: Voice typing: hold Super+Shift+Space (or nox voice toggle), speak, release; the text is pasted into the focused field. Local whisper.cpp on the GPU (nox voice setup builds it and downloads the model). language: auto | en | hi | ...; prompt: optional context that biases spelling (names, 'Hinglish in Latin script'). model: q5_0 | q8_0 | a .bin path. tidy: drop um / uh / repeats (the pill's TIDY chip and nox voice tidy keep a runtime choice in ~/.local/state/nox/voice.json). smartTidy: also run the text through claude -p (smartTidyModel; ~3 s). source: PipeWire node name ('' = default mic; `nox detect` sets the laptop mic in shell.local.json so Bluetooth headphones never drop into call mode while you talk). idleMinutes: unload the model from VRAM after this long unused (0 = keep). restoreClipboard: put the previous clipboard back after the paste. Audio is deleted after transcribing; transcripts are never stored.

notifications._comment: rules: [{ "appName": "^Spotify$", "mute": true }] - match appName/summary/body/desktopEntry (regex, case-insensitive); mute = history only, drop = discard, timeout = ms, urgency = low|normal|critical
